native_mechanisms: Walk both symbol-coil rows side by side in lockstep on the sunlit table and count only the fires (positions where the two shapes coincide) — a pure diagonal match tally, no grid built.

Allow the boundary door between the rows to break exactly once per crossing: one coil crouches past a quarrel (a single out-of-step slip), tried at every quarrel point, never twice, and the crossing still ends at the last coil.
Store each crossing's fire-pile in its own room, sink failed/twice-broken crossings into the underground tower (restart from the first coil), and return only the highest pile as the answer.
core_technique: Closed-form diagonal (gap-free) match score plus an O(n) prefix-max scan giving the best single insert/delete-pair offset correction in both directions, combined by max with a provable optimality bound; a k-bounded Ukkonen band anti-diagonal SIMD Needleman-Wunsch is invoked only as a guarded fallback when that bound fails.
